clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Lake Lordamere, Lake Skulker Moss draws the Royal Apothecary Society's attention. Apothecary Berard identified it as an organic part of research into brewing a New Plague before Arugal's curse claimed his mind.

Lake Skulker Moss is gathered from Lake Skulkers and Elder Lake Skulkers on the Dawning Isles. Before Arugal's curse claimed his mind, Apothecary Berard cataloged the plants and creatures of eastern Silverpine Forest. In his journal, he wrote that Lake Skulker and Lake Creeper mosses could stabilize or react with other ingredients. After Berard became Arugal's mindless servant, his journal was recovered from Pyrewood Village for Apothecary Renferrel. Renferrel sent Forsaken champions to gather moss and a rare tumor from local Vile Fin murlocs, then deliver both to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
